build_MimeClient: build a MIME client instance with a dataset and optional channel for federated learning
generate_local_update_MimeClient: generate a local model update from a server message containing optimizer state and control variate
batch_train_MimeClient: run a single minibatch gradient descent step using MIME gradient correction with control variate
reload_server_state_MimeClient: reload the server optimizer state into the local optimizer to synchronize training state
create_MimeClientConfig: create a MimeClientConfig dataclass with the target class name for MimeClient instantiation
